given_when_then.given: The Delivery Partner attempts to access the login interface
given_when_then.when: The system requests a primary credential (e.g., unique agent ID or biometric scan) before proceeding to secondary verification or authentication
given_when_then.then: The system blocks progression to the login attempt until a valid primary credential is provided or explicitly rejected

given_when_then.given: The Delivery Partner attempts to initiate a login sequence
given_when_then.when: A valid primary credential is provided
given_when_then.then: The system accepts the primary credential and permits the subsequent login attempt flow

given_when_then.given: The Delivery Partner initiates a login attempt
given_when_then.when: An invalid primary credential is provided
given_when_then.then: The system denies the login attempt and terminates the session without issuing a secondary verification code

success_criteria: The system must request a primary credential before displaying or enabling any secondary verification input field.
The system must not generate or display a secondary verification code if the primary credential is invalid.
The system must allow the login process to continue only after a valid primary credential is successfully validated.
The system must immediately terminate the session and deny access upon detecting an invalid primary credential.
